title: Dungeon, Cave, Interior, Isometric, Deck-Plan, Section & Multi-Level Builder
objective: Implement the shared room/level/vertical-projection cartography kernel for dungeons, caves, interiors, isometric/staggered views, deck plans, sections/cutaways and multi-level maps while keeping runtime topology and 3D truth owner-controlled.

scope.purpose: Provide one shared room/level/vertical-projection cartography kernel for enclosed, subterranean, vehicle/deck and multi-level map classes without becoming runtime topology or canonical 3D authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative dungeon, cave, interior, deck-plan, section/cutaway and multi-level documents can deterministically author and inspect shared room/level/vertical-projection state while runtime topology and canonical 3D truth remain external owner authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after MCS-13 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-14 is selected.
MCS-14 absorbs baseline MCS-16 into one shared room/level/vertical-projection kernel.

MCS-14 authors cartographic walls/floors/rooms/passages, caves/tunnels, openings, vertical connectors, roofs/overheads, objects/templates, floors/levels, blueprint/reference traces, GM layers and isometric/section/deck-plan projections only.
Runtime topology and canonical 3D truth remain owner-controlled and are not inferred from drawn geometry or vertical presentation.

MCS-14 is governed-started on branch work/mcs-14-dungeon-interior-multilevel-cartography from application main f7c648663d7cafa67a9f42d118d8913162bc1916; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
MCS-15, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the bounded MCS-14 room/level/vertical-projection seam, then implement only the required dungeon/interior/multi-level cartography behavior and continue through validation, publication and closeout without starting downstream work.
